annotations.title: Export a clip in other shapes or quality

description:
Use this when the user wants a finished clip in another shape or quality: "make a square version", "give me
        this in 16:9 for YouTube", "export it in 4K", "60 fps", "one for each platform". Each shape is rendered again
        from the clip's own edit and saved as a new clip in the Library; the original stays as it is.
        clip_id: from list_clips (a saved photo is refused). shapes: any of 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 (also 4:3, 3:4, 2:3,
        21:9), up to 4 per call; leave empty to keep the clip's own shape. resolution: 720, 1080, 1440 or 2160 (4K), the
        short side in pixels; leave empty to keep the clip's. fps: 24, 25, 30, 50 or 60; 0 keeps the clip's.
        On the free plan exports carry the watermark, and several shapes at once, 1440 and 2160 are Premium and refused;
        a plan with lower export quality refuses what it lacks, by name.
        Returns one job_id per shape with the title of the new clip. Next: job_status for each job_id; the new clips
        are then at the top of list_clips under those titles, and get_download_link gives each file.
        Not for: changing the look or framing (style_clip, frame_clip), a saved photo (get_download_link) or many
        clips in one file (download_all_clips). Free: no Horizon Units.
